rv.q: This seems like a play that could be experienced quite differently depending on the individual viewer’s background, and because of this very ambiguity, I can see it sparking some lively conversations.
Watching this succinctly told, beautifully layered story unfold is a cerebral and emotional delight that each theatergoer must enjoy for themselves.
Although the new year has barely begun, 'One Party Consent' is already a must-see highlight of the season.
Rising local playwright Omer Abbas Salem makes their own sturdy entry into the genre with One Party Consent , now in a world premiere at First Floor Theater under Nadya Naumaan's direction.
